verdict.rationale: Asana is a work-management SaaS. Its AI Teammates, AI Studio, MCP server and API are about tasks, projects and workflows, not coding agents that provision toolchains or install dependencies. Auto-detecting and installing development toolchains is outside this product category, and nothing in the evidence shows Asana shipping such a capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have a coding agent auto-detect and install the toolchains and dependencies it needs for a task
